tools.name: delete_observation
tools.description: Delete one observation from the archive by obs_id (get ids from search_observations). Use to prune a wrong or stale observation. It is removed now; facets that rested only on it are retired at the next review, and nothing is re-read. The profile (facets) itself is not directly editable — observations are the input layer.

obs_id.description: the obs_id to delete (get ids from search_observations)

tools.name: get_facets
tools.description: Read the synthesized growth facets (structured attributes) for a lens. Returns current facet values — trajectory arcs, mastery markers, resilience patterns. Defaults to the 'default' lens; pass lens='math' etc. for another lens. (Facets are per-lens, so there is no cross-lens 'unified' facet set — that aggregate exists only for the narrative; use get_profile for it.) For a readable prose overview instead, use get_profile.

lens.description: which lens to read, by the name 'witness lens list' shows (e.g. 'math'); omit for 'default'

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the narrative growth profile (readable prose) for a lens. Omit lens (or pass 'unified') for the cross-lens portrait — an aggregate blending ALL active lenses, not a lens itself. Pass lens='default' for that lens's OWN narrative (distinct from the unified blend), or lens='math' etc. for another lens. (This defaults to the unified aggregate, whereas search_observations/get_facets default to the 'default' lens.) For precise structured attributes instead, use get_facets.

lens.description: omit for 'unified' (the cross-lens portrait blending ALL lenses — an aggregate view, not a lens); or name one lens: 'default' (that lens's own narrative), 'math', etc.

tools.name: record_observation
tools.description: Record a decision-aware observation about the user's growth/change in THIS session. Use when you (the assistant) notice something worth tracking that you have context for now but a later reviewer would miss. Stored verbatim. Tag with the relevant lens.

dimension.description: which axis this observation belongs to

tools.name: search_observations
tools.description: Search the user's growth archive for observations related to a query. Returns past observations about how the user thinks/works/changes. Defaults to the 'default' lens; pass lens='math' etc. for another lens.

query.description: the growth/pattern question to search for

lens.description: which lens to search, by the name 'witness lens list' shows (e.g. 'math'); omit for 'default'
